_meta.note: replay of test windows through the DEPLOYED decision layer (k-of-n persistence, cooldowns, weather veto); window-level attribution: an alert counts correct if the window's true class matches the alert class
_meta.false_alarm_metric: threat-class alerts (chainsaw/gunshot/vehicle/human) whose window class differs; anomaly INFO alerts excluded from the rate and reported per class
_meta.node_day_note: replay clock = one hop per window; the test split class mix is a stress stream, not typical forest ambience, so per-node-day is an extrapolation of THAT mix
